tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page. Never pure black, so that everything above it has somewhere to recede to.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels and the sidebar: one step up from the page.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: A row under the pointer, an active nav item, an input.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and secondary buttons: the step above raised.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines. Light catching an edge, never a drawn grey line.

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: Inputs, unit plates and anything that has to look touchable.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Focus-adjacent edges and dashed free-slot outlines on the board.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: What the screen is about: names, numbers, headings. Off-white, never pure.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: The line of facts under a name; nav labels.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels above a value, timestamps, icons in the chrome.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Classifiers and keyboard hints. The quietest thing that is still readable.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Sodium amber. The one saturated colour: the next step on this screen, and the active section. Nothing decorative is ever this colour.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and the Today count: amber, lightened to read as text.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Guide-sign green: on route, on time, delivered, paid. State only.

tokens.name: ok-fill
tokens.usage: Ground of a load block that is running to plan.

tokens.name: ok-border
tokens.usage: Outline of a load block running to plan.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Late, overdue, unreadable, offline. Always with words beside it, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Ground of a late load block or an error note.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Outline of a late block or an error note.

tokens.name: neutral-fill
tokens.usage: Non-load time on the board, such as home time.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page, top left. Weight stops at 500: size carries it, not heaviness.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The figures a screen exists for. Set in mono so they line up.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text in the office app.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The line of facts under a name, in text-muted.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: The label above a figure. The only place small caps appear.

styles.name: driver-body
styles.usage: Driver app text, one step larger for a glance at a dock.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Money, unit numbers, ETAs and counts, so digits line up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and between board blocks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside rows and toolbars.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding and driver app card gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side padding in the office app.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Gap between the two columns of a wide screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Unit plates, status chips, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the surface a row shows on hover.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Driver app cards and the big driver button.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Status chips and badges.
